assessment_membership.source: C2-b authoring declaration (2026-09-26): this target is placed in the V1 placement bank's softener set by this cut's authoring review. The declaration is made here — no authoring fixture and no external assessment export in this repository places this target, so the membership is this review's own and is recorded as such.

texts.text: A softener placed before a description to make it less strong than the plain word would be.

As a softener, a bit stands directly in front of an adjective or an adverb: the room is a bit small, he arrived a bit late. No of comes between the softener and the modifier. With a noun the pattern changes to a bit of + noun, which is a quantity phrase rather than a softener: a bit of cake, a bit of help. A bit also modifies verbs in British speech (I like it a bit), and a little does the same work in both patterns.

The two patterns are the lesson: a bit before a modifier, a bit of before a noun. Learners who know a bit of + noun extend it to the modifier slot (a bit of small), which is the commonest slip, and learners whose first language has no article drop the a (bit small). The safe test is what follows the phrase: a modifier takes a bit, a noun takes a bit of.

a bit + adjective = a softener (the room is a bit small). a bit of + noun = a small quantity (a bit of cake). a little does both jobs (a little small, a little cake) and is slightly more neutral. quite can weaken or strengthen depending on the adjective and is not interchangeable here.
有点儿；稍微（放在形容词或副词前，把说法讲得不那么绝对）

pedagogical_profile.rationale: Bands are the C2-b authoring judgement (V1 carries no calibration data): the softener is common in speech, so receptive value is HIGH and receptive difficulty LOW; productive value and difficulty are MEDIUM because kind of, a little and quite cover much of the same ground and the of-intrusion has to be unlearned. Explanation cost is MEDIUM for the same reason. RESOURCE_PRACTICE follows the entity's own declared learning_intent DEVELOP. Revisit when Calibration100 response data exists.

pack_overlays.rationale: The softener belongs to the general fluency pack (high-frequency multi-word units), so it carries full weight in that pack's coverage accounting.

Softened assessments of this shape are ordinary in meetings and comments on a draft (the numbers are a bit high), so it carries more than half weight in the workplace pack; the shortfall records the casual register and that the pack's own review has not placed it.

example_policy.policy: Present at most two examples per attempt, whole sentences only: the canonical sentence first; a SUPPORTING or CONTRAST sentence only after the learner has attempted the canonical form twice without producing it. Never present the quantity phrase (a bit of cake) as a model of this target, and never present an ERROR_INSTANCE as a model.

typical_errors.error_pattern: a bit of + adjective | adverb (a bit of small, a bit of late)
typical_errors.explanation: a bit of belongs with nouns, where the phrase names a small quantity, and the pattern is extended to the modifier slot by analogy. The two shapes are not interchangeable: with of the phrase needs a noun after it, and without it the phrase needs a modifier.
typical_errors.detection_policy: Match when a bit of is followed by an adjective or an adverb, in a clause where no noun follows the modifier.

typical_errors.error_pattern: be + bit + adjective (the room is bit small)
typical_errors.explanation: Chinese has no article system (有点儿小), so the a in the softener is not produced and the phrase loses the word that makes it a quantity expression. The modifier and the word order are right; the determiner is missing.
typical_errors.detection_policy: Match when bit follows a form of be directly, with no determiner in front of it, and a modifier follows.

detection_policy.policy: Fires only on the learner's own produced English text, and only on a visible surface form: the words a bit, the word of and the class of what follows. No model judgement and no confidence score participates (PRODUCT_CONTRACT §8.1: V1 does not treat a model's self-reported high confidence as an R4 certification). Each rule below states the positive direction it must match; the fixture with the same ordinal states a case the rule must NOT match, so every rule ships with a testable boundary. expected values are NO_MATCH (the shape is absent) and NO_MATCH_BOUNDARY (a bit of is there with a noun after it, so the quantity phrase is in use and not the softener).

detection_rules.rule: OF_INTRUSION: match when a bit of is followed by a modifier (an adjective or an adverb) rather than a noun, because the softener takes no of.
ARTICLE_OMISSION: match when bit stands directly after a form of be with no determiner and a modifier follows, because the softener is the phrase a bit.

ACCEPTED_REALIZATIONS: do not match when a bit stands directly in front of a modifier (the room is a bit small, he arrived a bit late), and do not match a little in the same position: those are the accepted realizations.

QUANTITY_PHRASE_WITH_A_NOUN: do not match when a bit of is followed by a noun (a bit of cake, a bit of help) or when bit is the noun it normally is (the bit is broken), because the softener is not in use there.

detection_fixtures.text: The room is a bit small.
The numbers are a little high.
He gave me a bit of cake.
